title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify that the triplet F = 1 is the excited state and the singlet F = 0 is the ground state.

title: Final Answer for (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that the spin triplet state lies higher in energy than the singlet state.

title: Hyperfine Interaction Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the hyperfine interaction and how it affects the energy levels of the hydrogen atom.

title: Nuclear Spin States
description: Important Criteria: The student must describe the relationship between the nuclear spin states and the symmetry of the wave function in the hydrogen molecule.

title: Energy Level Diagram
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include a level diagram to illustrate the energy states of the hydrogen atom and molecule.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect signs in the magnetic interaction terms.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units used in the calculations and explanations are consistent and correctly applied.
